Fake or fact? "The sky is blue because it reflects the ocean." 🌊

❌ FAKE. Air scatters blue light far more than red. At sunset, light crosses more air, so reds and oranges are what's left.

The 60-second science 👇

#FakeOrFact #Science

Fake or fact? "A leap year comes every 4 years. Always." 📅

❌ FAKE. Century years skip it unless divisible by 400. 1900 had no Feb 29, 2000 did, and 2100 won't.

Why, in 60 seconds 👇

#FakeOrFact #LeapYear

Fake or fact? "Your phone's GPS needs the internet." 📡

❌ FAKE. GPS only listens to satellites. And thanks to Einstein, their clocks are corrected by about 38 microseconds a day, or your location would drift ~10 km.

👇

#FakeOrFact #GPS #Tech

Fake or fact? "Black holes suck in everything around them." 🕳️

❌ FAKE. From far away, a black hole pulls like any object of the same mass. Only things that get too close fall in.

The 60-second explainer 👇

#FakeOrFact #Space

One Moon, but two high tides a day. How? 🌊🌙

The ocean bulges on both sides of Earth. And it's not just the Moon: the Sun adds about half as much pull. Line them up and you get spring tides.

👇

#FakeOrFact #Science #Ocean

Good news you didn't hear: the ozone hole is healing. 🌍

The 1987 Montreal Protocol phased out CFCs. UN experts expect recovery by ~2040 for most of the world and ~2066 over Antarctica.
